GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. weakened when clear # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride +1kg over the allotted weight of 55kg. When questioned regarding the performance, Rider stated that the mare travelled satisfactorily throughout the event, however, shortly after straightening, he experienced some difficulty obtaining clear running when held up behind runner, which was weakening. He added that after shifting to the outside of that runner's heels to obtain clear running, the mare's finishing effort was plain and it failed to let down or display the turn of foot he had anticipated. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn , Held Up turn then steered into the cutaway, Made Some Ground to the line # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Briefly held up rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 3 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider reported that the mare raced flat and could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance other than that it may have come to the end of its preparation. Trainer advised that the mare will now be sent for a spell. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down Mid Field 2 lengths. looking for run tur 2 lengths. got around leaders 200 metres. ran on strongly # just too strong

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running inside the final 50m. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare at the request of stable staff, did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. # Every Chance
